experiments.claim: A prototype cue can remain an external input rather than teach the sharing rule
experiments.primary: paired cue removal and wrong-cue substitution on cached F10 checkpoints, taught and unseen families; wrong-cue following scored only when true and cued labels differ

experiments.claim: Cue timing changes what the learner retains after the cue disappears
experiments.primary: hidden/hidden, cue/cue, cue/hidden, hidden/cue, equal 1024+1024 updates and optimizer resets; phasewise transfer and actual-byte frontiers at 90% unseen accuracy

analysis: Qwen development experiment: no model-family generality claim. Use all seeds, fixed within-family unseen item split, conditional 16-label scores, separate hidden and supplied-cue rate targets. Learning failure remains an outcome, never a finite successful bit budget. No power-law fit across two prototype counts. Inference interventions on existing F10 checkpoints are retrospective; schedule contrasts are registered before new training.
